SimTestLab proposes one campus that tests, proves and certifies every part of clean energy: solar, wind, hydro, batteries and grid controls, before it reaches homes and industry.

Why this centre

Clean power is easy to make. Hard to keep.

1 · THE PROBLEM

Power comes at the wrong time

The sun peaks at noon, but homes and factories need most power in the evening.

2 · THE FIX

Store it in batteries

A battery energy storage system (BESS) saves noon power and releases it at night.

3 · THE GAP

Nobody here tests it end to end

Cells, BMS, inverters and grid controls are tested in separate places, or abroad.

Our answerOne campus that tests the whole chain, from one cell to a working microgrid, and certifies it as safe.

Every machine, sorted by when we buy it

Equipment list by phase

Battery storage (BESS)≈ ₹1.1 Cr per MWh

A 300 MW / 600 MWh Indian project cleared at about ₹670 Cr. All-in BESS outside China and the US: about $125/kWh. We budget ₹1.4–1.8 Cr/MWh for small lab-size units.

ESS News, Dec 2025 · Ember, Oct 2025
Solar PV field₹3.5–4.5 Cr per MW

Turnkey ground-mounted plant in India, so a 200 kWp campus field is about ₹80 L.

Bluebird Solar, 2026 price guide
Electrolyser$700–1,400 per kW

Containerised systems from about $700–1,000/kW; Western PEM about €1,400/kW. A 50 kW lab unit with water and power systems is about ₹1.2 Cr.

pv magazine, Mar 2024
Flow battery≈ $284 per kWh

Break-even capital cost for a 10-hour vanadium system. Small demo units cost more, so we budget ₹2.5 Cr for 600 kWh.

pv magazine USA, Mar 2024
EV fast chargers₹10–45 L installed

60 kW DC chargers from ₹10–20 L installed; 120 kW class up to ₹45 L. Two chargers plus a V2G unit: ₹55 L.

Bolt.Earth, 2026 price guide
Electron microscope₹30–80 L

Conventional SEM in India; field-emission models run ₹1–5 Cr. We budget ₹70 L for an SEM with EDS.

Bajaj Finserv price guide, 2026
Money by phase

Four phases, paid for in steps

Indicative equipment estimates (₹ L = lakh, ₹ Cr = crore). Land, buildings, utilities and staff are budgeted separately. Partner campuses can cut civil costs.
